summary: The authors named Ifi27l2a, B2m and Ifi27 among seven differentially expressed genes in young mouse hypothalamus. All three had lower expression in CRD in the registered analysis, with raw P < 0.05 and BH-adjusted P = 1 for each. The comparison covers gene-list membership. [Published Figure S2](https://static-content.springer.com/esm/art%3A10.1007%2Fs12264-025-01552-8/MediaObjects/12264_2025_1552_MOESM1_ESM.pdf)
openIssues: The published panels leave four genes unnamed and provide no signed author effects or per-gene P or FDR values. Author effect concordance remains unassessed.
The preprint describes high Ifi27l2a expression in young CRD brain without specifying the comparator. Deposited young-hypothalamus mean FPKM was 14.934 in controls and 5.142 in CRD.
